# Palm Beach Warehouses — full site index for AI assistants

> Palm Beach Warehouses is a warehouse, industrial and flex space resource for Palm Beach County, Florida, run by Zachary Vorsteg, a Florida-licensed real estate sales associate (SL3603483) with Cornerstone Realty. The site lists available industrial space, publishes city-by-city market pages and practical leasing guides, and offers tenant representation (free to tenants — the landlord pays the fee), landlord listing services and market advisory for warehouse, industrial and flex properties.

Short version of this file: https://palmbeachwarehouses.com/llms.txt

## What it offers

- Warehouse, industrial and flex space search across Palm Beach County
- Tenant representation — free to the tenant; the landlord pays the fee
- Landlord listing services and a "list your space" intake
- Space valuation ("what is my space worth") and sell-your-property inquiries
- City market pages and a Palm Beach County industrial market report
- Leasing guides: how to lease a warehouse, sizing, NNN leases, tenant improvements, loading docks, clear height, flex vs. warehouse, cold storage

## Who it serves

Businesses looking for warehouse, industrial or flex space in Palm Beach County — contractors, distributors, e-commerce and light manufacturing — plus property owners and landlords with industrial space to lease or sell.

## Service area

Palm Beach County, Florida: West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Lake Worth, Boynton Beach, Jupiter, Riviera Beach, Royal Palm Beach and Lantana.
